digest.component_or_area: code-review gate, model class configuration seam
propositions: A single REBAR_LLM_MODEL environment variable cannot simultaneously express different model classes for Pass-1 (finder), Pass-2 (verifier), and Pass-4 (coach) on non-default providers like Bedrock

Four code-review gate steps (base, round_a, round_b, coach) inherit cfg.model implicitly rather than declaring their intended class, causing them to use the wrong model family when cfg.model differs from the per-pass requirement

The batch step resolution path reads model_ladder from the batch sub-dict only and silently ignores step-level model declarations, making model_ladder the required key for batch steps to declare their class

Per-step model declarations must be deterministic and falsifiable by declaring single-rung class ladders rather than multi-step ladders, so the resolved model per pass remains testable and attributable to the correct class
